title: Pitfalls of Conversational LLMs on News Debiasing

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting conversational LLMs to generate debiased versions of news sentences (sourced from the BABE dataset) and having expert news editors evaluate the outputs using a 5-criterion journalistic checklist.
Evaluating LLM debiasing performance on news sentences containing subjective language by using expert human assessment to check if the text is unbiased while preserving facts and context.
Assessing LLM-generated debiased news text via expert evaluation to ensure factuality and objective presentation are maintained without adding misinformation or removing vital information.
Prompting models to remove discriminatory undertones from news sentences, followed by expert editorial evaluation of the model outputs for unbiasedness and semantic preservation.
